# The word aabbcc is generated by the $a^n b^n c^n$ grammar

The word $aabbcc$ over the alphabet $\{a,b,c\}$ belongs to the language of the grammar $G_{abc}$ for
$\{a^n b^n c^n : n \ge 1\}$.

A derivation is $S \Rightarrow aSBC \Rightarrow aaBCBC \Rightarrow aaBBCC \Rightarrow aabBCC
\Rightarrow aabbCC \Rightarrow aabbcC \Rightarrow aabbcc$.
